review_candidates.title: Director of Information Technology
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Role Description The Director of Information Technology is a full-time, on-site role based at Badr University in Cairo, responsible for leading the university’s overall IT vision, strategy, and operations. This role oversees the planning, implementation, and maintenance of technology infrastructure, including networks, servers, data centers, and core academic and administrative systems. Day-to-day responsibilities include directing IT teams, managing budgets, ensuring secure and reliable systems
eligibility_evidence: BUC places strong emphasis on academic excellence, research, and practical learning supported by extensive international collaborations.
